ground_truth: Reverted because caching a default SSLContext introduced edge cases and concurrency issues that outweighed the performance benefit.
Reverted for standard browsers because retaining the Content-Type header for FormData payloads broke browser FormData support.
Reverted because the annotation change broke Annotated custom validations such as AfterValidator, a use case missing documentation and tests.
Reverted because shallow-copying WhereNode children allowed reused querysets evaluated in nested nodes to mutate JOIN aliases.
Reverted because using multi-row INSERT statements on Oracle caused crashes with Oracle versions greater than 23.3.
Reverted because the subclass-identification refactor caused a performance regression.
Reverted because the admin sidebar change caused a visual regression when both navigation and filter sidebars were visible.
Reverted because restricting URL preparation to HTTP and HTTPS broke docker-py, while other IDNA workarounds were considered sufficient.
